text: Alla Haajaaka e leptugol on si on jaarnii Mo on gomɗinii Mo, si O Leptiray on ko junuubi mon ɗin. Si on moƴƴinii golle, on yettii Mo on gomɗinii Mo kene e gunndoo, alaa ko O Leptira on. Alla Laatike Jaarnoowo kala yettuɗo Neemaaji Makko ɗin, Annduɗo gomɗinal tagu Makko ngun, O Yoɓitoyay kala e golle mun ɗen.
